name: GitLab
description: Interact with GitLab repositories, merge requests, issues, CI/CD pipelines, and more via the GitLab API.
author: Anthropic

requiredEnv.name: GITLAB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
requiredEnv.description: GitLab Personal Access Token. Create one at https://gitlab.com/-/user_settings/personal_access_tokens

optionalEnv.name: GITLAB_API_URL
optionalEnv.description: GitLab API URL (defaults to https://gitlab.com/api/v4 for self-hosted instances)

tools.name: create_or_update_file
tools.description: Create or update a single file in a GitLab repository

tools.name: get_file_contents
tools.description: Get the contents of a file or directory from a GitLab repository

tools.name: push_files
tools.description: Push multiple files to a GitLab repository in a single commit

tools.name: create_issue
tools.description: Create a new issue in a GitLab repository

tools.name: create_merge_request
tools.description: Create a new merge request in a GitLab repository

tools.name: create_branch
tools.description: Create a new branch in a GitLab repository

tools.name: get_merge_request
tools.description: Get details of a specific merge request

tools.name: list_merge_requests
tools.description: List merge requests in a GitLab repository
